positions.as_written: Repair tissue has no zonal arrangement, so its layering is absent rather than altered.
Repair tissue is judged against native cartilage it was never going to match, so an orientation sensitive measure of its organisation would answer a question asked daily.
Repair tissue is called a failure for lacking a layering it cannot have.
